question.text: Which statement best reflects how the workbook describes the framework for commodity exchanges and clearing corporations?

answer.text: Exchanges are governed by SECC Regulations, 2012; commodity exchanges and SEBI stipulate clearing-member capital adequacy/net worth, and exchanges maintain surveillance, risk controls, and an Investor Protection Fund
Only a website and a trading platform are required
Only SEBI registration — no other requirements
Physical trading floors in every state are required

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook describes SECC governance for exchanges and clearing corporations, member net-worth/capital-adequacy norms set by commodity exchanges and SEBI, exchange-level surveillance and risk controls, and the Investor Protection Fund (IPF). The Trap: A website and trading platform alone, registration alone, or physical floors in every state are not the workbook's framework. Note: The pages checked do not enumerate a single SEBI requirement list including exchange net worth, robust technology, independent directors, investor protection committees, and regular SEBI inspections, so those specific governance details are omitted.
